description: Computers have been outperforming humans for years on tasks like solving complex equations or analyzing data, but when it comes to the physical world, robots struggle to keep up. It can take years to train robots to function in the messy chaos of the “real world” — but thanks to some unlikely help from the film and video gaming industry, robots today are using AI to fast-track their learning and master new skills using simulated environments. Rev Lebaredian is the vice president of Omniverse and…
classificationReason: A dedicated discussion of robot learning in simulation, NVIDIA Omniverse, physical AI, and robot assistance.
qualityReason: Substantive interview with a senior simulation executive and detailed technical and market framing.
